pandas.DataFrame.rename

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Change labels using a mapping or callable. A Series can also receive a new name.

Call syntax

DataFrame.rename(…) Full signature
DataFrame.rename(
    mapper=None,
    *,
    index=None,
    columns=None,
    axis=None,
    copy=…,
    inplace=…,
    level=None,
    errors='ignore',
)
